sections.title: Circuit, live
sections.intro: The track look: glowing blue sweeps on deep black, three small round gauges between the rev arc and the dial, and crisp thin digits. This is the real wallpaper, drawn in your browser by the app's own code. Tap the big gauge, and try Circuit's layouts and colours.

sections.title: About Circuit
sections.intro: Circuit is a track car's cluster: glowing blue sweeps on deep black, three small round gauges between the top arc and the big dial, and crisp thin digits.

items.alt: The Circuit style, as the wallpaper draws it
items.caption: Circuit, drawn by the app itself

items.title: €2.39, once
items.text: Buy Circuit once on Google Play and it's yours. On a new phone with the same Google account, it comes back by itself.

items.title: One dial, three jobs
items.text: The big gauge shows power, CPU clock or GPS speed. Tap it on your home screen to switch, as in every style.

items.title: Make it yours
items.text: Customize sets Circuit's colours and background, and its units, clock and warning lights.

items.title: Layouts, and your own
items.text: Most styles come in several layouts. You can also drag and resize the gauges and save your own.

sections.title: Layouts made with Circuit
sections.intro: Drivers built these layouts in Circuit and shared them in the app's layout market, most used first. Every layout works in every style.

sections.title: More styles
sections.intro: Every style runs live on its own page. Or try them all in your browser.

image.alt: The Prism style, as the wallpaper draws it

items.title: Prism
items.text: An angular tech cluster: two slanted panels of faceted glass, blue for the reading and red for the revs, with tilted bar scales and a thin neon outline.

image.alt: The Aura style, as the wallpaper draws it

items.title: Aura
items.text: Premium sport dials: chrome rings, a warm glow behind white numerals and big digital numbers, on graphite leather.

image.alt: The Pulse style, as the wallpaper draws it

items.title: Pulse
items.text: A neon HUD of rings: every reading a ring of light around the big number, magenta on black.

image.alt: The Vector style, as the wallpaper draws it

items.title: Vector
items.text: A neon HUD in hexagons: a faceted sweep that thickens as it climbs and crisp thin digits, violet on black.
